highlights.reason_zh: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 权重与 Granary v2 数据已开放，可直接验证多语种语音项目；厂商精度仍需目标音频复测。
highlights.reason_en: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe weights and Granary v2 data are open for direct multilingual speech tests; vendor accuracy still needs target-audio validation.

highlights.reason_zh: Copilot coding agent 的 workload identity 进入 public preview，直接影响 CI 与后台 agent 的凭据、撤销和审计设计。
highlights.reason_en: Workload identity for the Copilot coding agent enters public preview, directly affecting credential, revocation and audit design for CI and background agents.

highlights.reason_zh: Genie 4 展示交互式世界生成，但只有有限预览、没有开放权重或通用 API，适合了解能力边界而非投入集成。
highlights.reason_en: Genie 4 shows interactive world generation, but limited preview access and no open weights or general API make it an awareness item rather than an integration target.

highlights.reason_zh: Novelty Judge Bench 公开代码与数据，为研究 agent 的想法去重提供可复现起点，同时明确暴露弱标签限制。
highlights.reason_en: Novelty Judge Bench releases code and data for reproducible research-agent idea deduplication while exposing the limits of weak labels.

highlights.reason_zh: Codex 0.165 接入 Vertex AI，并扩展记忆迁移与会话分叉，直接影响跨 provider 的 coding-agent 工作流。
highlights.reason_en: Codex 0.165 adds Vertex AI, memory portability and broader session forking, directly affecting cross-provider coding-agent workflows.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功并完成阅读，并补查官方博客、GitHub、Hugging Face、研究仓库、中文及其他非英语线索与重大综合新闻。两条 overlap 漏检按 late discovery 入库。Anthropic 一篇文章只有日期、无法证明落在小时窗口内，Concordat 与部分 arXiv 条目在截止后公开，均留待下轮；厂商 benchmark 尚未独立复现。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were fully read, supplemented by official blogs, GitHub, Hugging Face, research repositories, Chinese and other non-English leads, and major general news. Two overlap misses were recorded as late discoveries. One Anthropic post exposed only a date and could not be placed inside the hourly window; Concordat and several arXiv items appeared after the cutoff and roll into the next run. Vendor benchmarks remain independently unverified.
